name: api-instruction-storage
goal: Store an editable instruction per task type in question_types and expose it on create/update/get.
design_constraints: Prerequisite: the duplicate Flyway V9 after merging dev is resolved first; use the next free version (V13 assumed after renumbering branch V9-V11 to V10-V12).
Instruction is display metadata: editable even when editability.runtimeFields is false (runtime-locked).
Plain text only, trimmed, max 500 chars; no client interprets HTML.
Create requires instruction; update treats null as keep-current so older callers keep working.
Existing permission rules in DynamicTaskTypeService.update stay unchanged.
Flyway (real environments) and the local-schema dev-seed must end with the same default texts copied verbatim from pte-app task_type_meta.dart.

repository_conventions.request_dto: Java records with bare Bean Validation annotations (no message attribute), e.g. @NotBlank @Size(max = N)
repository_conventions.response_dto: Records; new fields appended at the end of the canonical constructor, compatibility constructors pass null
repository_conventions.entity: Lombok @Getter/@Setter on QuestionType, @Column(name = snake_case, length = N)
repository_conventions.service: DynamicTaskTypeService trims user text before persisting; constants in internal/constant/ItembankConstants
repository_conventions.migration: Flyway V<n>__snake_case.sql; local-schema dev-seed statements separated by @@
repository_conventions.tests: Plain JUnit 5 + Mockito mocks + AssertJ, no Spring context

boundaries.module: itembank owns question_types and its DTOs; no other module touched in this phase

applicable_rules: docs/CODING_STANDARDS_API.md: validation at boundary via @Valid DTO annotations, not in service
docs/CODING_STANDARDS_API.md: files <= 300 lines (DynamicTaskTypeService is 270 before change)
docs/CODING_STANDARDS_API.md: no hardcoded user-facing strings in service bodies
Instruction update must sit outside the runtimeChange/isRuntimeLocked branch
allowed_exceptions: instruction column stays nullable in DB: custom task types created before V13 have no value; clients fall back

testing.report: 2026-10-30: DynamicTaskTypeServiceTest 6/6, PracticeCatalogServiceTest 8/8; itembank + architecture + PracticeSessionServiceTest run 170 tests, 1 unrelated failure (PackageDensityTest: billing/internal/dto/response has 17 classes, from dev merge of PR #86). Migration texts verified verbatim against task_type_meta.dart (23/23).

success_criteria: Migration contains ADD COLUMN instruction varchar(500)
Every task type with a TaskTypeMeta entry has one UPDATE
